title: Request dossiers and annotated notes — field summit extract
body:
Purpose:
Quick synthesis from the Feb 12–13 field summit and follow-up interviews. This is a compact dossier-style rollup for product and eng partners — focused on concrete asks, repeatable patterns, and low-effort probes we can run in the next sprint.

Scope & method:
- Source signals: 12 on-site customer interviews, 8 remote follow-ups, support ticket sampling (Q1 top-50), and two product demo sessions.
- Method: hand-curated clips -> cluster by intent -> assign tentative impact & effort bands. Notes capture sample quotes and friction vectors.

High-level takeaways:
1) Predictable tail-latency behavior is a showstopper for synchronous workflows (notably chat routing). Multiple customers reported spikes when parallel retriever calls happen.
   - Quote: "Great avg latency but the spikes break our realtime flow — we throttle anyway." - FinOps lead, anonymized
   - Suggested probe: run two-week latency tail profile for top-3 high-traffic routes; enable prefix-KV caching in Canary for one customer and compare token cost.

2) Rollout visibility + automatic rollback hooks. Customers want clearer rollforward/rollback signals in the Console and an API to trigger safe rollbacks (with canary exposure metrics).
   - Workaround currently: manual tag-and-annotation in deployment notes, slack alerts.
   - Low-effort deliverable: add a per-rollout smoke-check metric (500-sample prompt set) and a one-click rollback action tied to that metric.

3) Embedding cost transparency and chunking suggestions. Some teams mis-configure chunk size and pay for extra tokens without quality gains.
   - Ask: embedding-size recommendations by dataset type + a tiny visualizer in Console.

Customer dossiers (condensed):
- Retail analytics platform (large, prod): Wants ephemeral dedicated pools for peak marketing windows; willing to pay for burst SLA. Pain: region placement + audit logs for data residency.
  - Key ask: "Burst reservation that we can toggle for campaign windows."
  - Risk: procurement cycle long; need legal/KMS spec for private deployments.

- Mid-market SaaS (NLProc): Heavy embedding use, variable chunking; sees 18–32% token cost variance month-over-month.
  - Key ask: "Show me where tokens are going and suggest chunking fixes."
  - Quick win: add a token breakdown per-call prototype in Optimize UI.

- Healthcare pilot (on-prem): Wants private inference with HSM integration and immutable audit trail. Must pass a security questionnaire before next PoC.
  - Action: prep a security one-pager and HSM integration checklist.

Pattern synthesis (why multiple customers ask this):
- Many asks are about predictable economics and deterministic performance under load. This maps to two platform levers: routing/fallbacks and cache/batch tuning.
- Visibility is a recurring theme: Console telemetry surfaces exist but customers need example playbooks and curated defaults tied to workload archetypes.

Prioritization quick matrix (impact / effort rough):
- Rollout smoke metric + rollback button: High impact / Medium effort -> candidate for Q2 sprint.
- Token breakdown by route: High impact / Low effort -> skinny feature for Optimize.
- Dedicated burst toggle prototype: Medium impact / High effort -> requires ops & sales alignment.
- Embedding chunking visualizer: Medium impact / Low effort -> design + sample heuristics.
- HSM + audit one-pager for healthcare buyers: High impact / Low effort -> immediate deliverable for Solutions Eng.

Open questions / hypotheses to test:
- Does providing an automated chunk-size recommender reduce token spend by >10% across NLProc customers? (A/B test candidate)
- Are rollback smoke metrics predictive enough at 500-sample size? Do we need per-model thresholds?

Next steps (short list):
1) Product: scope a small Optimize panel for token-breakdown mock (Priya), due Mar 3.
2) Eng: instrument per-route tail-latency trace for 2 customers (Marcus), begin Mar 1.
3) Solutions: assemble HSM & security quick-pack for healthcare pilot (Diego), due Feb 21.
4) CS: run a 2-week pilot of prefix-KV cache enabled on one canary customer and report cost/latency delta. (Owner: Ava)

Notes to self (rough):
- Capture a set of 6 canonical prompt/route examples to use as smoke-set for rollouts. Put them in Confluence CS/Signal-Lab-2025.
- Link to Slack thread where Retail procurement flagged residency needs: #cs-enterprise-privacy (thread ts:164383).

Appendix: sample support threads (anonymized snippets):
- "We saw 700ms 95th during our 3pm spike — everything else looks fine."
- "If I could flip a button to reserve extra capacity for 6 hours I would."

If you want this split into separate ticket templates (rollout-smoke, token-breakdown, burst-toggle), I can draft JIRA stubs and attach acceptance criteria.

-- Ava
